verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Habits feature finds and auto-schedules recurring routines on the calendar, and the scheduler flexibly reschedules them when conflicts come up. That covers recurring time blocks, but nothing shows it running recurring automated jobs or multi-step workflows beyond placing calendar events. missing for 10: scheduling recurring jobs/workflows that execute actions (not just calendar blocks), workflow definition or triggers, API/programmatic scheduling, independent hands-on corroboration of recurring automation.
